report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Vikram Singh | Age: 48
Body Temperature at Scene: 21.7°C | Ambient Temperature: 25.2°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 9.4 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Facial: Periorbital ecchymosis bilateral [MODERATE]
  2. Neck: Compression marks consistent with ligature strangulation [SEVERE]
  3. Abdominal: Blunt force trauma with splenic laceration [MODERATE]
  4. Upper Limb: Defensive bruising on forearms [MODERATE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): Ketamine, Opiates

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed posterior — no repositioning detected.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a spontaneous violent altercation. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
